description.value:
A high-capacity storage drive, equipped with an onboard organic-to-digital communication bus, is installed in your cerebral cortex, giving you access to additional information on a narrow topic. While you have the memory expansion installed, you become expert in a single Lore skill, chosen when you install or improve the augmentation. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

Special If you have a datajack augmentation, a single memory expansion you have installed doesn't count toward your implant limit. Further memory expansions still count.
